source.sourceCategory: Category:Welcome! Pokémon Café: PikaVee's Mixing à la mode

leadText:
----
 
(Japanese: Welcome! Pokémon Café: PikaVee's Mixing à la mode) is a colored written by Sanae Suzuki and illustrated by Tomoko Fujinoki. It is the sequel of Pocket Monsters: PikaVee's Soothing DAYS. It is based on .

It was serialized in the magazine as (Japanese: Pokémon Café Mix: PikaVee's Spinning DAYS) from the January 2021 issue (released on December 1, 2020) to the November 2021 issue (released on October 1, 2021) and is serialized as (Japanese: Welcome! Pokémon Café: PikaVee's Mixing à la mode) since the December 2021 issue (released on November 1, 2021).

While the first volume isn't titled or numbered, the second volume is titled (Japanese: ~Cheerful Cooking!~) and the third volume is titled (Japanese: ~Sparkly Cooking!~).

It was announced in the December 2020 issue of Pucchigumi, released on October 30, 2020.
